name: Your Safe Harbor — Child-Safe Browsing
description: Free, local-first parental controls for Chrome: category blocking, parent rules, schedules, SafeSearch, and a safety guide.
//permissions: storage=settings; declarativeNetRequest+WithHostAccess=category/override rules without an extra per-host warning (still needs host perms); alarms=approval expiry + schedule transitions; downloads=download blocking; webNavigation=re-evaluate tabs on rule changes + minimal local block log. (chrome.management.getSelf() is used for force-install detection but needs no permission.)
//host_permissions: <all_urls> is REQUIRED because DNR redirect + modifyHeaders (unlike bare block) need host access. This is what produces the 'read and change all your data on all websites' install prompt. A parental-control filter legitimately needs it to redirect blocked navigations to the block page and to add SafeSearch headers.
